snippet.title: Abyss Prowler | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Control the battlefield through movement, positioning, and decisive action under pressure.

Abyss Prowler is a fast-paced precision movement combat shooter where every dash is a decision. Carve through dense enemy swarms, exploit openings in impossible situations, and master a combat system built around positioning, timing, and control.
